mcp.description: Submit an access-gated AlphaFold 3 scientific run.

input_mode.description: raw runs the CPU data pipeline; enriched consumes the verified reference artifact and skips preprocessing.

limitations: A source revision observation is not workload, hardware, semantic, or license qualification.
Candidate contract only: no BatchRun controller, Kueue Job, route, or credential is generated.
Reference databases require at least one TiB of shared ReadWriteMany storage; GPU-node ephemeral disk is not used.

The official-loader-v2 H100 run passed after correcting private-volume permissions (405 arrays, 368384602 elements, 41.42-second minimal inference, five CIFs), but the tested bead2e image reports a development identity; rebuild to a final digest and repeat the semantic gate before route qualification.
The user-authorized academic PoC may stage and execute the exact parameter asset only in restricted quarantine; formal institutional acceptance remains required for production promotion.
